ambient_nT.source: Dyal, Parkin & Daily (1973), 'Surface magnetometer experiments: Internal lunar properties', Proc. Lunar Sci. Conf. 4th, 2925-2945, Table 2 p. 2930 (1 gamma = 1 nT); cross-check Dyal, Parkin & Daily (1974), Rev. Geophys. 12, 568, doi:10.1029/RG012i004p00568 (abstract)
ambient_nT.note: Apollo 12 ALSEP lunar surface magnetometer, 38 ± 2 nT (deployed Nov 1969). Rule: median of the three stationary ALSEP sites (Apollo 15: 3.4 ± 2.9, Apollo 12: 38 ± 2, Apollo 16: 234 ± 3 nT). Measured sites range 3.4-327 nT (Apollo 16 Site 13); planned south-polar bases have no surface measurement.
